target.title: Fix fleet watcher rearm redraw loop
target.body:
Closes #1

## Summary

Fixes the fleet file watcher retry path so missing `~/.config/nameplate/fleet.json` does not trigger unnecessary settings publishes every 15 seconds.

`FleetFileWatcher.arm()` now reports whether it successfully installed a file-system watcher. The rearm timer only calls `onChange()` when rearming succeeds, preserving later fleet file creation detection without causing repeated menu bar redraws or overlay visibility checks while the file is absent.

## Verification

- `swift build`
- `git diff --check`

Manual runtime proof, using temporary local `PROOF` logging around `reloadFleetEntry()`, `FleetFileWatcher.arm()`, and the rearm callback. The logging was removed after the run and is not part of this PR.

Scenario:
1. Started the debug app with no `~/.config/nameplate/fleet.json`.
2. Waited past the first 15-second retry.
3. Created `~/.config/nameplate/fleet.json`.
4. Waited for the next retry.

Observed output:

```text
2026-07-08 15:36:05.978 Nameplate[...] PROOF reloadFleetEntry exists=false entry=false
2026-07-08 15:36:05.978 Nameplate[...] PROOF arm missing file; retry scheduled
2026-07-08 15:36:20.979 Nameplate[...] PROOF arm missing file; retry scheduled
2026-07-08 15:36:20.980 Nameplate[...] PROOF rearm fired armed=false
2026-07-08 15:36:35.981 Nameplate[...] PROOF arm installed watcher
2026-07-08 15:36:35.982 Nameplate[...] PROOF rearm fired armed=true
2026-07-08 15:36:35.982 Nameplate[...] PROOF rearm publishing onChange
2026-07-08 15:36:35.983 Nameplate[...] PROOF reloadFleetEntry exists=true entry=true
```
This shows the failed missing-file retry does not call reloadFleetEntry(), while later fleet file creation is still detected and publishes exactly once after the watcher is installed.
